metrics.title: Receive channel
metrics.description: 2.4 GHz channel tuned during this capture window. Compare traffic and signal on the same channel.

metrics.title: Observation duration
metrics.description: Milliseconds spent capturing in this window. Longer windows naturally collect more frames.

metrics.title: Captured frames per window
metrics.description: Frames delivered to the analyzer on this channel, including frames later rejected for RX or parse errors. This is not total channel traffic.

metrics.title: Captured bytes per window
metrics.description: Sum of delivered frame wire lengths, including FCS; scales with observation duration.

metrics.title: Management frames per window
metrics.description: Parsed Wi-Fi management frames such as beacons and association messages.

metrics.title: Data frames per window
metrics.description: Parsed Wi-Fi data frames received by the scanner; encrypted contents are not inspected.

metrics.title: Observed data retry share
metrics.description: Percentage of captured data frames with the retry flag. Missing when no data frames were captured; this is not packet loss.

metrics.title: Networks heard per window
metrics.description: APs heard on the receive channel during this window, excluding retained APs not heard now. Bounded AP table may evict records.

metrics.title: Active radios per window
metrics.description: Distinct retained peer radios with transmitted or addressed traffic on this channel in the window. Bounded table may evict records.

metrics.title: Average received signal
metrics.description: Mean RSSI of delivered frames at the scanner antenna in dBm. It is not the IoT device's own signal level; missing means no sample.

metrics.title: Raw noise-floor estimate
metrics.description: Mean raw radio noise-floor samples in dBm. Hardware accuracy is not yet validated; missing means no sample.

metrics.title: Blind interval before window
metrics.description: Milliseconds with capture stopped before this window, including reporting, channel changes and optional MQTT upload.

metrics.title: Queue drops per window
metrics.description: Captured frame callbacks lost because the bounded processing queue was full. Earlier radio loss is unknown.

metrics.title: Truncated prefixes per window
metrics.description: Delivered frames whose wire length exceeded the stored capture prefix; later bytes were unavailable for parsing.

metrics.title: Malformed headers per window
metrics.description: Delivered frames whose stored bytes could not be parsed as a MAC header.

metrics.title: Delivered RX errors per window
metrics.description: Frames delivered with a nonzero radio RX status. The sniffer does not expose complete CRC-error capture.

metrics.title: Off-window frames
metrics.description: Delivered frames tagged with another channel or a timestamp before this window; excluded from its traffic counts.

metrics.title: Table evictions per window
metrics.description: AP or peer records displaced when bounded analyzer tables filled; high values can undercount distinct radios.

metrics.title: Omitted connection events
metrics.description: Connection events displaced from the bounded local event list. Event identities and details stay in serial logs.
